import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
from imblearn.over_sampling import BorderlineSMOTE, SMOTE
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Create imbalanced dataset with overlapping classes
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=500, n_features=4, n_informative=3,
                           n_redundant=1, weights=[0.8, 0.2],
                           flip_y=0.1, random_state=42)

# Check class distribution before Borderline-SMOTE
print("Class distribution BEFORE:")
print(Counter(y))

# Apply Borderline-SMOTE
bs = BorderlineSMOTE(kind='borderline1', random_state=42)
X_bs, y_bs = bs.fit_resample(X, y)

# Compare with regular SMOTE
smote = SMOTE(random_state=42)
X_sm, y_sm = smote.fit_resample(X, y)

print("\nClass distribution AFTER Borderline-SMOTE:")
print(Counter(y_bs))
print(f"Borderline-SMOTE shape: {X_bs.shape}")

print("\nClass distribution AFTER SMOTE:")
print(Counter(y_sm))
print(f"SMOTE shape: {X_sm.shape}")

print(f"\nBorderline-SMOTE generated {len(X_bs) - len(X)} samples")
print(f"SMOTE generated {len(X_sm) - len(X)} samples")
